Welcome to Greenbriar Veterinary Hospital & Luxury Pet Resort. We are Maryland's Premier Dog & Cat Luxury Boarding Facility.
We are proud to announce the addition of our NEW Pet Rehabilitation & Therapy Program. Our program includes Hydrotherapy, Underwater Treadmill, Laser Therapy, Acupuncture, Massage Therapy, Therapeutic Exercise, Sporting Dog Conditioning, and more!
We are located in Urbana, MD convenient to the Frederick, MD area as well as the entire Maryland, Virginia, and D.C. areas. We are committed to providing your pets with the best pet health care through out all stages of their lives. Our luxurious amenities provide everything your pet needs and more! Our 30 acre facility provides a Veterinary Hospital, Pet Rehabilitation & Therapy Program, Luxury Dog Boarding, Luxury Cat Boarding, Pocket Pet Boarding, Grooming, Free Off Leash Dog Park, Doggie Day Camp, Do-It-Yourself Dog Wash and more.
